first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The slender, dark long gun held by Person A, with light-colored mottling and bright edges visible on its surface, located in the lower part of the image.

entities.name: muddy shell-cratered ground
entities.identification: The undulating, wet, dark black-brown muddy ground extending from the foreground to the midground, containing gravel, mounds, and low-lying trenches.

entities.name: cluster of ruined walls and rubble
entities.identification: The damaged gray-black masonry wall with a rectangular opening on the image-left side of the initial image, with its more distant portion obscured by smoke.

entities.name: cluster of dead trees
entities.identification: Multiple dark, leafless tree trunks of varying thicknesses in the midground and background, some retaining short branches and broken tops.

entities.name: smoke-cloud-filled sky
entities.identification: The large gray-white to yellow-green smoke-cloud-filled sky background behind the terrain and tree trunks.

entities.name: orange point of fire
entities.identification: The cluster of orange-yellow open flames visible among the terrain, with irregular flame contours and some brighter flame cores.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The first-person figure holding a gun, with dark-gloved hands visible holding it; the face and full body are outside the image.

entities.name: shell-crater water
entities.identification: The irregular, narrow, elongated gray-green water surface in the muddy trench at the lower right, with pale bright reflections and dark patches.

entities.name: ruins smoke cloud
entities.identification: The large area of dense gray to gray-black smoke extending from the image-left side to the center of the initial image, obscuring the wall and landscape behind it.

entities.name: black speck overlay
entities.identification: The black circular spots and irregular dark patches in the upper part and along the edges of the valid image, varying in size and having blurred edges.
